meta.name: web-typography
meta.description: Select, pair, and implement typefaces for web projects. Use when the user mentions "font pairing", "which typeface", "line height", "responsive typography", "web font loading", "type hierarchy", "variable fonts", "FOUT/FOIT", "typographic scale", or "the text is hard to read". Also trigger when choosing between system fonts and web fonts, optimizing font-loading performance, or designing readable long-form content. Covers readability evaluation, CSS implementation, and performance optimization. For overall UI design systems, see refactoring-ui. For dramatic typographic experiences, see top-design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网页项目挑选并实现字体搭配
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为网站选择或优化字体排版
copy.tagline_en: Select and implement typefaces for web projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to choose or optimize fonts for a website

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你选择、搭配网页字体，并给出 CSS 代码。它会评估可读性、优化加载性能，确保文字清晰易读。
howto.when: 当你提到“字体搭配”、“行高”、“响应式排版”、“网页字体加载”等关键词，或要求优化长文可读性时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这篇博客文章选一个衬线字体搭配无衬线字体。
say.note: Claude 会推荐字体组合并给出 CSS 代码。

say.text: 检查一下这个页面的排版，给出可读性评分。
say.note: Claude 会按 10 分制打分并指出问题。

say.text: 用 clamp() 写一个响应式字体大小公式。
say.note: Claude 会生成从手机到桌面平滑缩放的 CSS。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you select, pair, and implement web fonts with CSS. It evaluates readability, optimizes font-loading performance, and ensures text is clear and legible.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "font pairing", "line height", "responsive typography", "web font loading", or ask to optimize readability for long-form content.

say_en.text: Recommend a serif + sans-serif pairing for my blog article.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest font combinations and provide CSS.

say_en.text: Score the readability of this page's typography.
say_en.note: Claude will give a score out of 10 and list issues.

say_en.text: Write a clamp() formula for responsive font sizing.
say_en.note: Claude will generate CSS that scales smoothly across viewports.
